description: List tables and views in a database.schema of the configured Snowflake account. Requires database and schema. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the table list itself is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Enumerate the tables and views inside a specific database and schema in Snowflake -- the SECOND drill-down step, after a schema is already chosen -- before writing a query or calling describe_table. Requires database and schema. Dispatches asynchronously; results land on job completion.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the table list -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message: tables, a list of {name, kind} objects.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what tables exist'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the table list itself lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the table names and kinds plainly (low sensitivity, data_sensitivity 0.1) and suggest describe_table on one to go deeper.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List tables in a Snowflake database.schema.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.invalid_params: missing database or schema. snowflake.api_error: the schema does not exist or another warehouse error occurred.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.invalid_params: supply both database and schema, from list_databases/list_schemas.
